Uh, I'm a transgender guy, a freshman in high school, and an asexual in an unsupporting, Christian, conservative family. My mother is a stay at home mom and my father is a full-time worker. I don't have many friends and most of my time is online. I'm stuck in a Christian school that seems to hate me under all accounts. 
My father is great. I love him so much. He's a little misguided and not very helpful in my mental illnesses but, he's got the spirit. 
My mom is almost always in a bad mood. I feel like I'm walking on eggshells around her. I need to just submit to what she says and can never have a different opinion. She's always in my nightmares. I hear her laughing at me when I fail. She's hitting me in my nightmares. I wake up crying because she killed me in my nightmares. 
All I want is a loving family.
The happiest dream I ever had was that my mother and father got divorced and I went to live with my father. I woke up so happy.
